text:
Maria Chen: FYI forwarding Samir's escalation — billing looks off for embeddings + rerank. Dashboard shows ~3.4k input vectors this week, invoice line shows 7.1k. Samir says rerank spikes coincide with embed usage. Attaching the minimal repro he shared. Can someone triage?

Samir (customer): Hey team — here's a tiny repro. We batch 3 docs per request to /v1/embeddings, but the invoice units are much higher than dashboard. We also used the rerank endpoint once for a quick test — could that double-count?

Samir (customer): curl:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"embed-large-1536","input":["short doc A","short doc B","short doc C"]}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

Alex Kim: thanks — couple quick checks: 1) is the dashboard showing "vectors created" or "inputs received"? 2) need the request_id from Samir's header so we can look up server logs. Rerank endpoint often does extra work (query embedding + candidate embeddings) — could explain multiplier.

Maria Chen: added request_id from Samir: req_9f3b2a. Also pasted the invoice excerpt he sent (sanitized):

Billing Bot: Invoice 2026-02-19:
- embedding.compute: 7,120 units
- search.rerank: 2,040 units

Maria Chen: Dashboard (UI) snapshot (same day):
- embeddings created: 3,414
- rerank calls: 12

Jordan Patel: wild guess: two separate causes could be adding up: 1) rerank triggers internal embedding ops per candidate (so 1 rerank call * N candidates => N embedding ops), 2) batch vs single-input tokenization/truncation — dashboard might show "successful embeddings" but invoice counts every internal call including retries/fallbacks.

Ada Rivera: also confirm what we bill: embeddings are billed per input vector created (not per token) for the embeddings product; however some legacy rerank/search endpoints bill every internal embedding compute as a separate unit. If Samir's rerank used a dense re-ranker that embeds both query + candidates, that could add ~ (#candidates) embeddings per rerank call.

Alex Kim: I pulled logs for req_9f3b2a — server shows three client vectors created as expected. But I also see an internal rerank job tied to same customer_id that created 4,682 embedding computations earlier the same billing period (internal job id rk-44f). There's an unusual high-volume job at 2026-02-18T03:12:44Z with user-agent matching their SDK. Could be a looped job or an SDK bug.

Maria Chen: Samir — can you confirm if you run background indexing or scheduled reranks? Any SDK version pinned? Also did you call the "search.rerank" endpoint intentionally?

Samir (customer): We have a nightly indexing job that batches all docs in 10k chunks. We only called rerank manually once. SDK is pinned to 0.9.1 — we recently updated but rolled back last week.

Jordan Patel: that nightly job explains the bulk. Two follow-ups: 1) the SDK v0.9.1 had a bug where batch retry on partial network failure could resubmit some items without dedup keys. 2) if their job split into many small batches, the rerank/internal calls might amplify counts.

Ada Rivera: action items:
- Support: ask Samir for the nightly job logs and confirm job timestamps (we have a matching high-volume job).
- Billing: we'll run a reconciliation for customer_id and the period, check for obvious duplicate request_ids and retry patterns. If we find automatic resubmits from our SDK, we will credit for duplicated units.
- Engineering: add a short-term flag to surface "internal embedding calls" on the dashboard so customers can map invoice lines to internal ops. Longer-term we'll change retry semantics or add dedup keys.

Alex Kim: for repro, Samir can run a small script to reproduce the SDK retry behavior (we suspect network-level 502 triggers). Example minimal repro to capture request IDs:
```python
import requests
for i in range(3):
    resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', json={
        'model':'embed-large-1536',
        'input':['a','b','c']
    }, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer REDACTED'})
    print(resp.headers.get('x-request-id'), resp.status_code)
```

Maria Chen: Samir sent the nightly job log — looks like repeated batches at 03:12:40 - 03:13:12 with 502/timeout retries. Each retry created fresh request IDs. Also saw SDK 0.9.1 in the user-agent.

Samir (customer): OK thanks — we weren't aware retries would double-bill. We can throttle and upgrade SDK. What's next on credits?

Billing Bot: Flag created: billing-audit-1720. Temporary hold on automated collections for invoice 2026-02-19 while audit completes.

Ada Rivera: we'll run dedupe on request_id and compute duplicate units. If duplicates > 5% we'll issue credit and add note to invoice. Est. ETA 3 business days.

Alex Kim: follow-up to docs: add explicit note about batching + retries vs rerank amplification. Also surface vector dims in the UI (dimensions not billed but shown for transparency).

Maria Chen: thanks team — closing loop with Samir: advise upgrade SDK to >=0.9.3 (patch fixed retry dedup), throttle nightly job, and we'll follow up with billing credit after audit. :thumbsup:

Samir (customer): Appreciate the quick triage. Will patch and re-run nightly test and share logs.

Ada Rivera: marking support ticket escalated -> billing + eng. I'll post the audit link here when ready.

Alex Kim: noted, and we'll track if any rerank endpoint changes needed to reduce internal embedding counts.

Maria Chen: closing thread for now, will reopen if audit finds additional surprises. :pray:
